# Judah Lewis

Judah Lewis is an American actor, best known for his work in film and television, particularly in roles during his youth and teenage years.

## Notable Roles

- **"The Babysitter" (2017)** – He starred as **Cole Johnson** in this Netflix horror-comedy directed by McG, which became one of his most recognized roles.
- **"The Babysitter: Killer Queen" (2020)** – He reprised his role as Cole in this sequel, also on Netflix.
- **"Demolition" (2016)** – He appeared alongside Jake Gyllenhaal in this drama directed by Jean-Marc Vallée.
- **"Game of Silence"** – He appeared in this TV series.

## Personal Details

- He was born on **June 22, 2001** (though some sources may vary slightly).
- He began acting at a young age and built up his career through a mix of film and television work.

## Other Information

- He has appeared in various smaller or supporting roles in other projects throughout his career.
- He gained a following particularly among younger audiences through his Netflix films.

---
